remediations.description: Risk-register full refresh for Stages 34-39 + fix stale G-075 rows. The register's dated refresh block stops at Stage 33 (C6-R4); Stages 34-39 have no rows (frontend honesty, session-store grounding invariant, bidirectional-CDC diagnose path + Hard-Rule-3 posture, facilities/energy SIL-0 gate, slice decision-log persistence). ALSO: two older rows still carry stale G-075 wording ('OPEN, no live caller', 'first real PLC caller @18 must pass them') even though the Stage-33 refresh block correctly marks G-075 CLOSED — reconcile them to CLOSED. Docs-only hygiene.

Run a REAL reference pilot + publish a real-world A/B (G-035/G-043) — the single biggest fundability gap, unchanged since CTO #6 (C6-R6). Convert EVERY sim/documented-input headline to real evidence on real site telemetry: repair -47.9%, supply -51%/-98%, slice -190min, detector 1.0, AND the two NEW Stage 33-39 headlines that need real-world validation — the energy MILP (peak -22.1% mean on the sim's nominal_kw + a DOCUMENTED ToU/demand tariff; needs a real utility tariff + metered-load validation) and the bidirectional-CDC diagnosis (hand-coded documented thresholds; needs real edit->outcome traces). Buildable pilot package is ready (Stage 32). Buyer-blocked, not free/local-buildable.

Accredited functional-safety certification (G-011) + EU provider obligations. G-075 is now code-CLOSED (Stage 33 capability tokens), so the sil_bridge->certified-PLC seam is ready for an accredited IEC-61508/ISO-13849-1 assessment. Needs an accredited body + a certified safety PLC + a real cell + a legal-entity provider to sign the DoC / CE-mark / EU-register. Buyer/accredited-body/legal-entity blocked.

Horizontal-scale tail (G-066 tail) — multi-node HA + read-replicas/partitioning + fleet-magnitude load test (Stage 25 shipped the single-node shard-router foothold; the tail stays pilot/cloud). PLUS SPIRE SVID auto-renew (G-084, still OPEN) — adopt the containerised workload_x509_source / an SVID-renewer sidecar for CI/long-lived deployments so the agent SVID doesn't lapse at the 1h TTL.

Execute the dependency-refresh on a dedicated branch + isolated staging/CI (G-055/G-056/G-070). Stage 36 (C6-R2) PROVED via non-mutating dry-runs that a free/local in-place refresh is a stack-breaking cascade (langchain-core 1.x -> langgraph 1.x + langgraph-checkpoint 4.x + starlette 1.3.1 which conflicts with fastapi's starlette<0.42; a2a-sdk -> protobuf 6.x) and documented the migration plan. The remediation now is to RUN that plan in an isolated environment (not the working env) and re-verify the full live suite + refresh the SBOM — adopting a2a-sdk + langchain-mcp-adapters once the stack is bumped.
Supply-chain latency-spike detector sensitivity-floor complementary detector (G-083 residual b, ~6.4x-median floor) — carried from C6-R9; a complementary signal, disclosed today, pilot-time option.

Optional new build increment (no gap blocks it): the last un-built head-agent embodiment domain, Workforce & Safety (G-017) — video safety monitoring / ergonomics / demand-matched scheduling. Facilities/Energy (G-018) was built Stage 38 and Quality/Inspection (G-016) was advanced (ResNet18 99.3%); Workforce remains the open domain. Free/local-buildable if the operator chooses to continue building rather than pilot.
